title: TeleGuard
summary: TeleGuard is a telecom anomaly-detection pipeline that uses a GAN to synthesize minority-class anomaly records, rebalancing an imbalanced training set to improve rare-anomaly detection recall. It calls SDV's CTGANSynthesizer for tabular synthesis, SDV's Metadata/SingleTableMetadata for schema detection, and SDV's evaluate_quality for a quality score.
